record.question: The teacher glanced through the letter perfunctorily
record.explanation: Answer D: carefully. The task asks for an antonym. Doing something perfunctorily means doing it with little care or interest. “Carefully” provides the direct contrast; casually and hastily do not. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/perfunctorily. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
